title: 第一卷 第2639章 学习圣火回灵丹第一卷 第2638章 绝品祖龙造化丹
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：葬天一剑第一卷第2639章学习圣火回灵丹（..la）王霖的心情此刻沉入谷底，郁结难舒。
他万万没有想到，林尘竟然真的与他踏入了同一个层次。
如此一来，李川接下来的抉择必然摇摆不定，天平恐怕不会再像最初那样毫无悬念地倒向他这边。
这种突如其来的变数，让他胸口憋闷，难以畅快。
而就在王霖满心烦闷之际，一个让他心头一跳的变化赫然闯入眼帘。
林尘丝毫没有停歇的迹象，他的炼丹炉非但没有沉寂下去，反倒愈发炽烈。
空气中弥漫的丹香，骤然之间变得更加浓郁，那香气仿佛凝成了实质，穿透鼻腔，直抵肺腑，浓烈得令人心惊胆颤。
饶是王霖心有不甘，此刻也忍不住深深吸了几口，任凭那诱人的气息在体内流转。
与此同时，林尘的丹炉上方，原本只有一道凝实的丹纹，此刻竟开始缓缓浮现出第二条丹纹的雏形，轮廓虽还浅淡，却已是清晰可辨。
见状，王霖的脸色骤然大变，整个人仿佛被一道雷霆击中，震撼到了无以复加的地步。
他原本拼尽全力、耗尽心神的极限，不过是想让自己的丹药晋升到二纹祖龙造化丹的品阶。
可如今，林尘却不费吹灰之力般，轻易就将这层壁垒踏破，朝着更高处迈去。
这让王霖心头生出了一种望尘莫及的挫败感，脸上满满的皆是说不出的郁闷与不甘。
站在一侧的李川，此刻也是猛地瞪大了眼珠。
在这之前，他对林尘其实并没有抱太多的信心，直到亲眼见证了林尘这堪称逆天的表现之后，他内心的天秤终于开始动摇，甚至隐隐生出了一丝倾向。
他开始觉得，与其求助于老牌的王霖，或许将这个重任交托给林尘更为合适。
毕竟，林尘所展露出来的丹道天赋，实在是太过惊艳，强如王霖这般的人物，在此刻也被林尘稳稳地压了一头。
王霖脸上的不甘几乎化为实质，可再多的不甘之下，心底又忍不住生出一股深深的无力与无奈。
他很清楚，在祖龙造化丹的较量上，他已经无力再与林尘争锋。
这抹郁闷的神色从他的脸上一闪而过，但很快又被压了下去。

他毕竟是一位久经风浪的老牌炼丹师，即便一时受挫，心态也还能勉强稳住。
很快，王霖轻哼了一声，声音里夹杂着几分刻意的不咸不淡，开口说道：“不过就是运气好罢了，侥幸让他炼出了一枚二纹的祖龙造化丹。
此子体内本就有着不俗的龙血威能，靠着这一点先天优势，炼制此类丹药自然占了些许便宜。
但这并不意味着，待到炼制圣骨回灵丹的时候，他还能拥有同样的运气和优势。”
王霖这番话说得流畅，显然是极善于替自己找补的。
然而他话音刚落，就连李川都忍不住暗自摇了摇头。
在场之人都心知肚明，体内怀有龙血之力，对于炼制祖龙造化丹的确有些微裨益，可这种所谓的“加成”
不过是微乎其微罢了。
王霖此举，分明就是技不如人输给了林尘，心有不甘，才会如此急不可耐地替自己铺设台阶。
这般狭隘的格局，看在李川眼里，越发让他心里的天平倾向了林尘。
林尘毕竟是年轻一辈中惊才绝艳的天骄，若让他来炼丹，虽说未必真能确保他口中声称的那般拥有足足八成的成功率，但既然敢放出此等豪言，想来把握也绝不会低到哪去。
相比之下，王霖这位本该气度沉稳的老牌炼丹师，却一句接一句地明讥暗讽，实在落了下乘。
而就在王霖话音将落、还没来得及为自己的找补松一口气时，他忽然像是被什么掐住了喉咙，双眼骤然暴睁。
惊骇欲绝的一幕发生了，在他的视线中，林尘那座看似平平无奇的炼天炉里，那一颗浑圆剔透、流光溢彩的丹药上方，空气一阵波动，赫然间，第三道丹纹正缓缓凝聚成形！
三道丹纹！
这意味着林尘此刻在炼丹之道上展露的造诣，已远非他能企及。
至少，在炼制祖龙造化丹这件事上，双方的实力差距已如鸿沟般分明。
先前还能勉强摆出的淡然表情，在王霖的脸上瞬间崩碎，荡然无存。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Chapter 2639 of Volume 1 of The Sword of Burying Heaven, Learning the Holy Fire Resurrection Pill (..la) Wang Lin's mood sank to the bottom at this moment, and it was difficult to relax.
He never expected that Lin Chen would actually be on the same level as him.
As a result, Li Chuan's next decision will inevitably be unsettled, and the balance may no longer be as unsuspecting as it was at the beginning.
This sudden change made his chest feel tight and made it difficult for him to relax.
And just when Wang Lin was feeling depressed, a change that made his heart skip a beat suddenly came into view.
Lin Chen showed no signs of stopping. Instead of going silent, his alchemy furnace became even more intense.
The fragrance of red pepper that filled the air suddenly became more intense. The fragrance seemed to have condensed into substance, penetrating the nose and reaching the heart of the lungs. It was so strong that it made people tremble.
Even though Wang Lin was unwilling to do so, he couldn't help but take a few deep breaths at this moment, letting the alluring breath flow through his body.
At the same time, above Lin Chen's pill furnace, there was originally only one solid pill pattern, but at this moment, the prototype of a second pill pattern began to slowly emerge. Although the outline was still faint, it was clearly distinguishable.
Upon seeing this, Wang Lin's expression suddenly changed, and his whole body seemed to be hit by a thunderbolt, which was extremely shocked.
He originally tried his best and exhausted his mind to the limit, but he just wanted to upgrade his elixir to the level of the second-line Ancestral Dragon Creation elixir.
But now, Lin Chen effortlessly broke through this barrier and headed higher.
This gave Wang Lin an unparalleled sense of frustration, and his face was filled with unspeakable depression and unwillingness.
Li Chuan, who was standing on one side, suddenly widened his eyes at this moment.
Before this, he actually didn't have much confidence in Lin Chen. It was not until he witnessed Lin Chen's incredible performance that his inner balance finally began to waver, and he even had a faint tendency.
He began to feel that instead of turning to the veteran Wang Lin for help, it might be more appropriate to entrust this important task to Lin Chen.
After all, Lin Chen's alchemy talent was so amazing that even someone as powerful as Wang Lin was firmly outclassed by Lin Chen at this moment.
The unwillingness on Wang Lin's face almost turned into reality, but no matter how unwilling he was, he couldn't help but feel a deep sense of powerlessness and helplessness in his heart.
He knew very well that he was no longer able to compete with Lin Chen in the competition of Zulong Good Fortune Pill.
This depressed look flashed across his face, but was quickly suppressed.
After all, he is a veteran alchemist who has weathered many storms. Even if he is temporarily frustrated, his mentality can still be barely stable.
Soon, Wang Lin snorted lightly, his voice mixed with a bit of deliberate saltiness, and said: "It's just good luck, and he was lucky enough to refine a second-line Ancestral Dragon Creation Pill.
This child already has considerable dragon blood power in his body. Relying on this innate advantage, refining such elixirs is naturally a bit advantageous.
But this does not mean that when it comes time to refine the Holy Bone Recovery Pill, he will still have the same luck and advantages. "
Wang Lin spoke fluently and was obviously very good at making amends for himself.
However, as soon as he finished speaking, even Li Chuan couldn't help but shook his head secretly.
Everyone present knows that the power of dragon blood in the body is indeed slightly beneficial to refining the Ancestral Dragon Creation Pill, but this so-called "addition"
It's just a tiny bit.
Wang Lin's move was clearly due to his inferior skills and unwillingness to lose to Lin Chen, which was why he was so eager to lay the steps for himself.
Seeing such a narrow structure in Li Chuan's eyes, the balance in his heart tilted more and more towards Lin Chen.
After all, Lin Chen is an extremely talented person among the younger generation. If he is allowed to make elixirs, although he may not be able to guarantee the full 80% success rate as he claimed, since he dares to release thisIf you think about it, it will never be too low.
In contrast, Wang Lin, a veteran alchemist who should have a calm demeanor, made sarcastic remarks one after another, which really made him inferior.
And just when Wang Lin was about to finish his words and before he could breathe a sigh of relief for his explanation, something suddenly seemed to be grabbing his throat, and his eyes suddenly opened wide.
A horrifying scene happened. In Lin Chen's sight, in Lin Chen's seemingly ordinary heaven-refining furnace, the air above the round, clear, and radiant elixir fluctuated. Suddenly, the third elixir pattern was slowly condensing and taking shape!
Three elixir patterns!
This meant that Lin Chen's accomplishments in alchemy were far beyond his reach.
At least, when it comes to refining the Zulong Good Fortune Pill, the strength gap between the two sides is as clear as a chasm.
The indifferent expression that he could barely put on before suddenly shattered on Wang Lin's face and disappeared.
